target: age_DPD: days after organoid dissociation, not intact-organoid biological age or lifespan
metadata_join: recording_filename_well, one to one; cell_line/batch/age_DPD must agree
eligibility: All rows in the published development-withNAP table with no treatment or vehicle control; no activity-based exclusion
primary_protocol: Leave one connected plate/batch component out. Link plates sharing any cell_line + batch, so plates 41/42 stay together.
secondary_protocol: Leave one donor cell line out, excluding all linked plate/batch groups of that line from training. Evaluate only that donor line.
sensitivity: Primary protocol after restricting to no-treatment rows, with its smaller age range reported separately.
transforms: log1p mean firing rate, burst count, network burst count; retain other source columns

models.firing_rate_ridge: Log firing rate only; Ridge alpha10
models.activity_forest: All six features; 200 trees, max_depth4, min_samples_leaf5, seed42, n_jobs1

preprocessing: Fit median imputation with indicators and scaling inside each training fold only.
evaluation: Retain all pooled and per-fold MAE/RMSE/R2 and all predictions. No clipping, tuning, or claims of independent organoid replication.
limits: Published five-minute well averages, not a one-hour recording model.
Organoid-derived dissociated 2D cultures, not intact organoids.
Five sampled ages and only six donor lines; repeated wells are dependent.
Late timepoints contain fewer vehicle-control wells; missingness/selection may affect prediction.
External transfer to FinalSpark is not tested; remaining lifespan is not predicted.
